CI_PL_CTN.vi: Số thùng trên hóa đơn ≠ Packing List

CI_LINE_DESC.vi: Hóa đơn dòng {no}: mô tả hàng không khớp model {model} (Packing List thì khớp)

compare._doc: Cross-document comparison. columns = document sources (PL is the packing-list part of the CI file). src maps column -> extracted field (items.X = values of X over the line items). type: text | party (company name; CO., LTD. = COMPANY LIMITED) | terms (payment terms; 'By' and punctuation ignored) | goods (words of the description; quotes, BRAND, AND and plurals ignored; one side may list the goods one item at a time) | number | date | set | port | vessel | hs | po (reference tokens of 8+ letters/digits, so 'PR123456789012/10' = PR123456789012) | docref (reference no.; a value cut off at a line end matches the full number it starts, as in rule CO_INVOICE_NO). A column missing from src = not applicable for that field.
